patch_description: Replace the offset YY gates (wires [1,2], [3,4], [5,6]) in the second entangling block with CRX gates using the same "ent_nn" parameter. This increases gate diversity while maintaining parameter economy (still 6 distinct params). CRX gates provide tighter parametric coupling and more directed gradient flow, which should improve separation on hard samples (worst_group_margin) by concentrating learning on the boundaries between difficult classes. The offset pattern is preserved, maintaining staggered entanglement across the chain.
